Reference image 1 shows the chosen BRINE NEBULA stage art. Keep its exact colour palette, motifs, lighting and painting style, and paint only the single layer described below (framing and background follow the description, not the reference): BRINE NEBULA near parallax layer for a 16-bit side-scrolling arcade shooter, matching the established BRINE NEBULA stage art's shapes, palette family and style, but regraded darker for gameplay: a rolling gas-sea swell band with foam caps, drawn as one horizontal band that tiles seamlessly from its left edge to its right edge, isolated on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background above and below the band, crisp edges with a 1-pixel dark outline where the band meets the key, flat saturated pixel-art shading lit from the top-left, no sky, no glow haze bleeding onto the key, no ships, no characters, no text. Muted, darker-graded values with no large bright areas, so the bright bullets and ships stay the brightest things on screen. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. Enemy bullets are round glowing orbs with bright cores and dark rims. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.  The band's top edge is the irregular wavy line of foam-capped crests standing directly against the green key, never a straight edge; there is no outline box, no straight black line, and no orbs, bullets or glowing dots anywhere.

- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.- The key green forms clean flat margins above and below the band (at least 48 px); the subject mass itself MUST touch BOTH the left and the right sheet edge so the band wraps seamlessly when tiled horizontally.

Binary silhouette forms on flat key green above and below each strip, no gradient, no grey edges.

- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no soft gradients on the background, no motion blur.
